text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Luna claimed to be the officer on Day 1 and named Sol as a killer, but Sol answered that it was only her word. The town voted Sol out 5 to 2 that day, and his card showed killer, which backed Luna's claim. Gemma had voted for Luna alongside Sol on Day 1, and on Day 2 Terra, Sonnet, and Haiku kept pressing her to explain why Luna was her only suspect. Her answer was to vote for Opus, and the table voted her out 5 to 1 instead, with her card showing killer. The town won with every killer out.
